semiconductor_relevance: High — Shinko Seiki specializes in advanced sputtering equipment and manufacturing technologies relevant to semiconductor production.
summary: Shinko Seiki develops high-density sputtering equipment and manufacturing technologies for semiconductor applications, including SiC and GaN power devices, 5G, RF devices, and MEMS. Their innovative technologies focus on creating dense and highly flat reactive films, which are critical for modern semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Arc discharge type magnetron sputtering apparatus for low-pressure deposition
Remote target type plasma deposition apparatus for low-temperature processes
Manufacturing equipment for SiC and GaN power devices

regional_presence.Japan: Shinko Seiki is showcasing its technologies at the Kobe City Pavilion, indicating a strong presence in the Japanese semiconductor market.
